selected_primary_idea.title: GenomeFlux: Phylogenetically Paired Inference of Genome-Size Gain-Loss Balance
selected_primary_idea.research_object: Comparative nuclear genome-size evolution in land plants and selected outgroup lineages.
selected_primary_idea.mechanism: Differential repeat-family amplification, WGD, deletion/compaction, and lineage context jointly determine observed 1C values.
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: A bidirectional, quality-gated gain-loss model provides more stable out-of-clade explanation of genome-size contrasts than a gain-only or WGD-only model.
falsification_conditions: Gain-only or WGD-only model equals or outperforms the full model under preregistered held-out-clade validation.
Effects vanish after quality, phylogeny, and annotation controls.
Critical provenance or repeat/WGD evidence is insufficient.

rejected_ideas.title: Universal TE explanation
rejected_ideas.reason: Violates survey evidence and ignores compaction, WGD, and lineage specificity.
